definition: Having more than one possible meaning; unclear or uncertain.
example: The instructions were ambiguous, so nobody knew what to do.

definition: Kind, generous, and caring about others.
example: The benevolent teacher always stayed after class to help struggling students.

definition: Being careful to avoid danger or mistakes.
example: Be cautious when crossing a busy street.

definition: To give time and energy to something important.
example: She dedicated two hours every day to learning English.

definition: Expressing ideas clearly and effectively in speech or writing.
example: The president gave an eloquent speech that moved the entire audience.

definition: Able to change or adapt easily to different situations.
example: A flexible schedule allows you to study at any time.

definition: Feeling or showing thanks for something received.
example: I am grateful for all the support my teacher has given me.

definition: A proposed explanation for something that has not yet been proven.
example: The scientist tested her hypothesis with a series of experiments.

definition: To suggest something without saying it directly.
example: Her silence seemed to imply that she disagreed with the plan.

definition: To give a good reason for something; to explain why something is right.
example: Can you justify why you were late to the meeting?

definition: Very interested in or enthusiastic about something.
example: She is keen on learning new languages every year.

definition: To stay somewhere longer than expected or necessary.
example: The smell of fresh bread lingered in the kitchen all morning.

definition: Paying great attention to every small detail; very careful.
example: He was meticulous about checking his essay for grammar mistakes.

definition: To discuss something in order to reach an agreement.
example: The workers negotiated better working conditions with the company.

definition: Hopeful and confident about the future.
example: Despite the difficulties, she remained optimistic about passing the exam.

definition: To continue doing something even when it is difficult.
example: If you persist in practicing English every day, you will improve quickly.

definition: Closely connected to or important for the topic being discussed.
example: Make sure your examples are relevant to the main argument.

definition: Genuine and honest; meaning what you say.
example: A sincere apology comes from the heart, not just from words.

definition: Complete and careful, covering every detail.
example: The teacher did a thorough review of all the grammar rules before the test.

definition: At risk of being hurt, either physically or emotionally.
example: Children are vulnerable to the influence of social media.
